items.title: BYD snaps longest streak of sales declines
items.summary: Chinese EV giant BYD broke its sales decline streak in May, with global sales rising 0.3 per cent to 383,453 units. This growth was driven by strong overseas shipments, which surged 80.4 per cent, offsetting a 24 per cent drop in domestic sales amid fierce competition and weakening demand.

items.title: TVS Srichakra Approves Rs 220 Crore Capex for Capacity Expansion at Madurai Plants
items.summary: The board of directors of TVS Srichakra Limited has approved a capital investment of up to Rs 220 crore to expand production capacities at its manufacturing facilities located in Vellaripatti, Madurai. The decision was finalized during a board meeting on May 27, 2026, according to a regulatory filing submitted to the stock exchanges.

items.title: JK Tyre Unveils One Of Its Largest Capex Plans As Capacity Utilisation Crosses 90%
items.summary: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd has announced one of its largest-ever capital expenditure plans, approving a Rs 4,980 crore phased expansion of its truck and passenger car radial tyre capacities amid strong demand across domestic and export markets. The expansion, approved by the company’s board, will increase overall capacity by 24% over the next three years and will primarily focus on the Chennai and Mysore plants.
